items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: This bastard went and got Mr Faletti and told him that I had hit him and he should get rid of me. Falletti told him yes, and now you come with me because you've had enough to drink.

ctx.x: So I went to the bar and asked this jerk what was the idea of insulting my wife and the girls that were with her? He started to puff up and asked me who the hell I was. I swung a right to his chin and that knocked him off of his stool. Cosey was standing near and the blow glanced and caughted him on the jaw but it didn't hurt him.

This bastard went and got Mr Faletti and told him that I had hit him and he should get rid of me. Falletti told him yes, and now you come with me because you've had enough to drink. This guy turned out to be the American vice-consul and was known to raise hell when he started juicing and nobody liked him. Faletti and everyone else that knew about this ass were glad that I had put him in his place. I was sorry that I didn't break his neck.

The morning passed and we still had a good time and went into the year of 1937 in the groove. I even took a couple of puffs from Leon's peace piece pipe cigarette to celebrate in New Year. Later in the season, there was a big diplomatic ball at the hotel and the vice-consul came. And he stayed the whole night. He gave me a look as if to say that trumpet player must be out of his mind.
